v4.5.2 — fix update loop + garbled characters

🐛 FIXED
• Update check now uses GitHub Releases API — the update banner only appears when a real installer is actually published. Eliminates the loop where the app kept suggesting the same update after installing it.
• Removed garbled 2-3 character sequences (corrupted Unicode) that appeared before tab names, button labels, and other UI text throughout the app.
